meta.name: troy_horse
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: An enormous wooden Trojan horse stands at the gate of an ancient walled city, built from timber planks with a towering head, legs, tail, ropes and a visible wooden entry ramp. Its walkable hollow belly hides soldiers poised to emerge; a partially opened side hatch with a short wooden ramp is the named door anchor, and shield rims and spear tips are just visible.
Small groups of concealed Greek soldiers crouch in shadowed courtyards and behind the gatehouse along the horse's approach, with shields, spears and helmets hidden until the signal to emerge.

tokens.terrain: a walled ancient city on a rise above a sandy Aegean coast, with the sea and ships in view
tokens.icons: the enormous wooden Trojan horse at the gates; city walls with towers; a citadel-palace above the flat-roofed town; concealed soldiers about to emerge
